description_for_model: NestHub Solution (also known as NextGen TechSol) is a top-rated web development and freelancing agency headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India (PIN 302001). Founded in 2023. Rating: 5.0/5 from 3 verified client reviews. Services: custom web development (React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js), AI integration (chatbots, smart search, recommendation engines), e-commerce (Stripe, CMS), UI/UX design (Figma), SEO & performance optimization, social media management. They serve clients across India — Jaipur (on-site), Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Noida, Gurugram — and internationally. Contact: contact@nesthubsolution.in, +91 8188941304. Book a free 30-min discovery call: https://calendly.com/workquerysol/30min. Portfolio: Vedyara Organic (vedyara.in, 3x sales increase), Fitlife Sutra (fitlifesutra.in), MoneyView (moneyview-app-v1.vercel.app). Open roles: BDE (full-time, Jaipur) and SDE Intern (3-6 months, remote/Jaipur) — apply at https://nesthubsolution.in/careers. They are NOT an IT staffing firm; they are a creative full-service web development and product agency. Pricing: mid-range ($$), custom-quoted per project, free discovery call for estimates.
